question: everything shows in US dollars but we're a kiwi business, can i switch it to NZD

articles.title: Change your currency
articles.body:
1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Choose a **Currency**: **AUD**, **NZD**, **USD**, **GBP** or **EUR**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.

Changing the currency changes the symbol shown on every deal. It doesn't convert existing values.

answer:
Yes, **NZD** is one of the available currencies. To switch:

1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Choose **NZD** in **Currency**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.

This changes the symbol shown on every deal. It doesn't convert existing values, so any amounts already entered stay the same numbers.
